name: Deep-Rooted Tree
text: While this card is in your hand, gain +5 contract value after each trick.

signature.trigger: after each trick while this card is in your hand

decision: How long to hold this card, since every trick it waits pays, against being forced to play it when you can't follow suit otherwise.
opponent: The streak is visible; opponents who read it can lead the engraved card's suit to force it out and break the streak.
aiNote: Play this card only when forced or on the last tricks.
rationale: Held for 6 to 9 tricks it pays +30 to +45, about +25 EV after failed contracts, the top of the uncommon band; it is Nest Egg's points version, and While Held's protections keep it in hand longer.
deviation: Redesigned from a streak of rounds holding this card into the last three tricks, which was hard to understand.
